title: The event guest list shows each holder's ticket type, ticket count and amount, totals holders per type, exports to CSV and can resend or refund a ticket

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-27 (project thread: Trace the House of Fates payment); audit /mnt/project-files/payments-audit/PAYMENTS-ORDERS-TICKETS-AUDIT-2026-11-27.md items 1, 2, 8, 9

detail:
Owner ask 2026-11-27: 'Space owners should easily be able to see and manage tier ticket holders from every relevant surface.' Before: the Manage > Guests roster read event_tickets without the tier, quantity or amount, so every buyer showed a plain 'Ticket' chip, a 3-ticket purchase read as one head, there was no per-tier total with names, no export of the guest list, and no way to resend a ticket (a guest's emailed ticket is their only copy).

DONE 2026-11-27: the roster reads tier, qty and amount for every ticket (a member who holds both an RSVP and a ticket carries it on their one row); each row shows 'VIP x3 · $132.00'; a line above the list totals tickets and buyers per ticket type; Export CSV downloads name, email, status, ticket type, tickets, paid, attended and joined; Resend sends the original receipt to the address it first went to, gated on host, cohost or staff and pinned to the event; Refund is the same host refund the public page's Sales list already offers, now on the holder's row. No migration.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
